{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: control the Unity Editor through the unity CLI","id":"gh:1349900532","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"unity-plugin","slug":"opdsh/unity-plugin","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","game","game-development","game-engine","gamedev","unity","unity-editor","unity3d"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: control the Unity Editor through the unity CLI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Unity Plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Build Unity games with an AI agent.** This plugin connects DeepSeek Harness to the Unity Game Engi"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ne, so you can describe what you want in plain language and the agent does the work inside the Unity"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" Editor: creating projects, building scenes, writing and attaching C# scripts, importing your Asset "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"Store purchases, running tests, and producing builds."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It talks to the Editor through Unity's official `unity` command-line tool, so everything happens in "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"a real, running Editor and stays in sync with what you see on screen."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What you can do"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Start a game from scratch.** "Create a new 3D project called SpaceRunner using the URP template""},{"id":"p7s2","text":" and the agent picks the template, creates the project, and opens the Editor.
- **Build scenes by ta"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"lking.** Add GameObjects, position them, attach components, wire up prefabs. Scene commands round-tr"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ip in well under a second with no recompile.
- **Write gameplay code.** The agent creates C# scripts"},{"id":"p7s5","text":", waits for the recompile, and attaches them to the right objects. It can also run C# directly insid"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"e the Editor for anything that has no dedicated command.
- **Put your Asset Store library to work.**"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" The agent can search the assets you own on the Unity Asset Store ("My Assets"), download them, and "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"import them straight into the open project. See Using your Asset Store assets.
- **See and test the "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"result.** Take screenshots of the Scene view, enter and exit Play mode, run EditMode and PlayMode te"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"sts.
- **Ship it.** Kick off player builds for your target platform.
- **Learn from Unity's own play"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"books.** The plugin bundles Unity's official agent skill collection (UI, physics, optimization, mult"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"iplayer, package management, and more), so the agent follows Unity best practices instead of guessin"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"layer, package management, and more), so the agent follows Unity best practices instead of guessing."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Before installing, make sure you have:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 or newer.** Older versions are not supported.
2. **The `unity` command-l"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ine tool**, installed, signed in, and with an activated license. Check with:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"3. **Unity 6.0 or newer** installed through the Unity Hub. Live control of the Editor requires Unity"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" 6.
4. **Python 3.9 or newer** (only needed for the Asset Store feature; no extra packages required)"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"6.
4. **Python 3.9 or newer** (only needed for the Asset Store feature; no extra packages required)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Each project you want the agent to drive needs the `com.unity.pipeline` package. You do not have to "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"add it by hand: the agent can install it for you, or you can run it once yourself:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Add the plugin to the DeepSeek Harness profile you use:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"That's it. Start the harness and ask the agent to make a Unity game."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Other install sources (GitHub or a local checkout)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Installing from GitHub builds the package on install, which pnpm blocks until the package is allowli"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"sted. If the first attempt fails with `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED`, add this to the profil"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run the command again:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A local checkout installs as a link and needs no allowlist entry, but you must build it first with `"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"pnpm install && pnpm build`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"To confirm the plugin loaded, run `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` and look for the `# == unity-"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"lugin loaded, run `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` and look for the `# == unity-plugin` section."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Your first session"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"1. Open the Editor for your project, or let the agent create a new one.
2. Ask for something concret"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"tor for your project, or let the agent create a new one.
2. Ask for something concrete, for example:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"> Open the project at C:\Games\SpaceRunner, add a Player capsule at the origin with a Rigidbody, and"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" write a script that moves it with WASD."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"3. The agent checks which Editors are running, discovers the commands the Editor offers, makes the c"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"hanges, and saves the scene."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Tips:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- The agent launches the Editor with the `-automated` flag so no dialog boxes block it. If you open "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"the Editor yourself, that's fine too; the agent will find it.
- The first time a new project opens, "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"Unity imports assets and can take a few minutes. The agent waits for the Editor to report "ready".
-"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" Ask the agent to take a screenshot whenever you want to see what the scene looks like."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Using your Asset Store assets"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Most people never need to change anything. If you do:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## What's included"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Agent tools**"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| `unity_status` | List running Editors the plugin can talk to. |
| `unity_list_commands` | Discover"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" the connected Editor's commands and their parameters. |
| `unity_command` | Run one live Editor com"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"mand, such as `create_gameobject`, `get_scene_hierarchy`, or `save_scene`. |
| `unity_eval` | Run C#"},{"id":"p39s4","text":" inside the Editor with full `UnityEngine` and `UnityEditor` access. |
| `unity_cli` | Everything el"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"se the CLI offers: `projects create`, `open`, `pipeline install`, `templates list`, `editors`, `test"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"`, `build`, `auth`, `license`, `logs`. |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**Skills**"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- **Unity's official skill collection**, downloaded from Unity-Technologies/skills: unity-cli, new-u"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"nity-project, build-live-game, the UI family, package management, physics, optimization, multiplayer"},{"id":"p41s3","text":", and more.
- **unity-workflow**: how to drive the Editor safely with the tools above (check status "},{"id":"p41s4","text":"first, bootstrap a project, the scene loop, tests and builds).
- **unity-asset-store**: search, down"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"load, and import assets you own from the Unity Asset Store."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"A project- or user-level skill with the same name overrides a bundled one."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"- The Editor command set is discovered at runtime; the plugin does not pin or validate per-command p"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"arameter schemas.
- `unity_cli` starts one CLI process per call by design; only the four live-Editor"},{"id":"p44s3","text":" tools use the warm session.
- The Asset Store feature works on Windows and macOS only."}],"truncated":true}
